title: Complete numerical multilingual frontends and translation
objective: Implement P6 canonical frontend intent, natural MATLAB and Wolfram numerical lowering, outward Sage/Python-SciPy/MATLAB/Wolfram code generation, round trips, explicit unsupported diagnostics, docs, fixtures, and benchmarks over the shared numerical semantics

oracles: existing MATLAB and Wolfram parser/runtime behavior

handoff.summary: Implemented versioned canonical numerical frontend intents with detached live bindings, stable unsupported diagnostics, a checked portable scalar-expression IR, caller-owned adapter composition, and the complete P1 scalar-root path. MATLAB fzero and Wolfram FindRoot now execute through canonical root intent; Sage, Python-SciPy, MATLAB, and Wolfram generation round-trips to identical semantic digests. Added CPython and Sage.js tests, offline provenance fixtures, public schema/documentation, integration instructions, and a representation-overhead benchmark.
risks: The unclaimed shared architecture/package-graph.json does not yet own src/lib/sagejs/numerics/frontends/, so architecture and merge gates stop at that integration boundary.

The full integration suite is blocked by an unchanged number-field baseline: test/number-field-class-unit-engine.cjs consistently reports result.complete false for cubic unit saturation after 34 neighboring tests pass.
Only the proven P1 scalar-root domain is registered on this branch; P2-P5 packages must provide their own OperationAdapter values when integrated.
next_steps: Integration lane: add the frontend prefix to the numerical-computing package owner, add the five frontend modules to pyrightconfig.json, and re-export the selected API from sagejs.numerics.
Integration lane: compose adapters from the P2-P5 domain packages and add MATLAB/Wolfram parser routing for aliases beyond the existing fzero and FindRoot paths.
Number-field owner: resolve or classify the persistent cubic unit-saturation integration failure, then rerun the exact integration receipt.
After shared integration changes land, rerun all four receipts and set this task to review.
